earnings.title: Vertex Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Total revenue increased 12% to $3.44 billion compared to the third quarter of 2025, primarily driven by the continued performance of cystic fibrosis (CF) therapies and growth from diversification into additional disease areas.

In the U.S., total revenue increased 10% to $2.17 billion from continued strong CF patient demand, including from new initiations of ALYFTREK; higher realized net prices in CF versus the prior year; and contributions from CASGEVY, JOURNAVX, and PALSONIFY.

Outside the U.S., total revenue increased 16% to $1.27 billion from strong CF performance across multiple geographies, including ALYFTREK uptake; increased CASGEVY infusions; and a favorable impact from foreign exchange.
GAAP net income was $654 million compared to $1.1 billion for the third quarter of 2025.
Total revenue $13.15 to $13.25 billion $13.1 to $13.2 billion

quotes.text: Vertex delivered excellent third quarter results marked by strong revenue growth across the increasingly diversified portfolio, continued advancement of the R&D pipeline, and the successful close of the Crinetics Pharmaceuticals acquisition.
quotes.by: Reshma Kewalramani, M.D., Chief Executive Officer and President of Vertex

outlook: Vertex today raised its full year 2026 total revenue guidance to $13.15 billion to $13.25 billion from $13.1 billion to $13.2 billion previously.

Embedded in this guidance are expectations for continued growth in CF, $500 million or more in revenue from CASGEVY and JOURNAVX combined, and $40 million to $50 million in revenue from PALSONIFY following the closing of the Crinetics Pharmaceuticals transaction on September.
Vertex GAAP guidance also includes approximately $500 million of compensation and transaction expenses noted above.
